_comment: The vendor's own name, prices and contact channels, shipped inside the build. Copy this to vendor.json and fill it in — or write it from the console's Developer section, which is where it is meant to be edited. Nothing here is secret and nothing here is trusted: it is text a restaurant reads on its licence screen before it has ever been online. Whatever the installation later fetches from the licence server replaces it.

activation.note: One payment. The licence does not expire.

transfer.note: Moving your licence to another computer.

instructions: Message us with your Restaurant ID and we will send your key.
